purpose: Canonical single-app and multi-app artifact ownership and output routing for every current user and manager skill.

discovery.scope_boundary: manager skills never write user .ai-docs and user skills never write manager maintainer/

source-mutation.media_type: repository source, configuration, or Git metadata
source-mutation.required_format: preserve the selected repository's existing format and owner conventions

managed-markdown.required_format: canonical .ai-docs path and the project artifact-format-contract.json

prototype-bundle.required_format: canonical .ai-docs prototype path and the project artifact-format-contract.json

chat-report.required_format: no persistent file unless the user selects a path

manager-repository.media_type: manager repository Markdown, JSON, scripts, or release archive
manager-repository.required_format: maintainer/** or plugins/** only; never a user project .ai-docs path

portable_routing_baseline.scope: Track B Phase B0 read-only host capability and topology evidence; this baseline neither installs hooks nor modifies an external project.

claude.deny: exit code 2 with stderr or a documented decision response

codex.matcher: apply_patch, Edit|Write, Bash, MCP or other local-function tool name
codex.input: JSON stdin; Bash and apply_patch use tool_input.command
codex.trust: new or changed non-managed hook definitions remain pending review until trusted through /hooks

bypass_boundaries: hosted tools and remote services outside the local hook path
specialized tool paths that opt out of the default hook path
shell-internal dynamic paths after an allowed command has started
external processes and writes outside the project root
portable_routing_baseline.reuse_decision: extend artifact-output-contract and harness-setup eval; reuse existing setup/bootstrap/context templates and the read-only Claude case; create Codex adapter and portable bundle only in later approved phases.

portable_routing_bundle.scope: A project-owned, plugin-neutral bundle definition. It defines schemas, adapters and a no-write planning installer; it does not install host hooks or activate trust.

claude.input_contract: PreToolUse JSON stdin with tool_name and tool_input; project root from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
claude.output_contract: allow=exit 0 empty stdout; deny and adapter/core failure=exit 2 with stderr reason
claude.merge_rule: merge only the managed PreToolUse entry; preserve unrelated settings

codex.input_contract: PreToolUse JSON stdin; matcher apply_patch|Bash; Bash and apply_patch inspect tool_input.command
codex.output_contract: allow=exit 0 empty stdout; bypass=exit 0 systemMessage; deny=exit 0 hookSpecificOutput{hookEventName=PreToolUse,permissionDecision=deny,permissionDecisionReason}; adapter/core failure=same exit 0 deny response (exit 2 did not block in Codex CLI 0.154.0 Windows smoke)
codex.merge_rule: merge only the managed hooks.json entry; never add inline [hooks] to .codex/config.toml

installation.absolute_path_rule: Shared artifacts and managed host config use project-relative paths only. Runtime scripts derive the current checkout root locally and never persist it in Git-managed output.
installation.local_state: .ai-docs/.harness/routing-state.local.json (Git-ignored per PC installation, trust and config hash)

gates.G10: required before writing host-local hook files or merging host config
gates.G13: required before Claude hook activation or Codex /hooks trust
